rows.title: Germinal products templates are answered on the germinal set's own pages, and using one starts a seeded germinal products notification
rows.detail: Template creation offers Germinal products alongside Live animals, because templates carry their type and the animals backend stores both. A germinal products template is answered on the germinal set's own question pages in template mode: the same template mode the live-animals pages get, applied to the germinal pages, never a copied template journey. So a germinal template has no Additional details task and asks no CPH number or permanent address. It is saved, listed with the category 'Germinal products', viewed, changed and deleted like any template. Using it starts a germinal products notification in the germinal set, seeded only with the answers that fit that set: the main reason for import, the purpose in the internal market when the reason is 'Internal market', and the storage temperature when it is one of the germinal temperature options. 'Certified for' is the germinal set's fixed 'Germinal products', and nothing about unweaned animals is asked or seeded.
acceptanceCriteria: Choosing Germinal products (semen, ova, embryos) on the type question in template creation, then naming the template, opens the germinal set's first question page in template mode, with the 'Template' caption and the template's name (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 6, 16, 127; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 26-30; c-265)
A germinal products template's task list has no Additional details task, and no page in it asks for a CPH number or a permanent address (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 16-18)

In template mode a germinal products page asks no arrival date, refuses a malformed answer, needs the page's required answers on 'Save and continue', and saves without the required checks on 'Save and return to overview'; the template can be saved with sections unanswered (c-308 default; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-095)

A saved germinal products template is listed on Manage templates with the category 'Germinal products', and can be viewed, have a section changed, and be deleted like a live animals template (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 51; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-066; c-266)

Pressing 'Use template' on a germinal products template starts a germinal products draft notification in the germinal set, with a GBN-AG reference, and opens the germinal set's task list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 6, 51; c-266; c-309)

A notification started from a germinal products template whose reason is 'Internal market' has its main reason for import and its purpose in the internal market already answered; one whose reason is anything else has the reason answered and no purpose (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-067; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 21)

A notification started from a germinal products template has its storage temperature already answered when the template's temperature is one of the germinal products temperature options, and unanswered otherwise (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-069; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 21)
A notification started from a germinal products template is certified for 'Germinal products', and no page asks about unweaned animals (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 19, 57)

sources.ref: claims 26-30, 34-35 (template mode on the same pages; template-mode checks)

openQuestions: c-308 (question, with a default the builder follows and says so): in template mode, does a germinal products page keep the notification's required-answer checks? Default: yes; malformed answers are refused, 'Save and continue' needs the page's required answers, 'Save and return to overview' saves without required checks, no arrival date is asked and sections may be left unanswered (req-2049).
rows.notes: Combines req-1876 (germinal templates answered on the germinal set's pages, saved, listed, viewed, changed, deleted and used like any template) with req-1875 (what using one seeds): both are seen through the same germinal template, made and used once, so building them apart would repeat the set-up. Template mode is the same mode the live-animals pages get from the split-off type-question-and-templates theme, applied to the germinal set's pages (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 5, 30). The template-mode checks criterion follows c-308's default; req-2049 itself is status 'question', so it is not listed in this row's requirements, but its default is observed here for the germinal set. The germinal arrival-details criterion (no arrival date in template mode) is the germinal half of req-290 and req-291, which the split-off theme holds and asked to be observed here. Repos: frontend and tests only; the template store that carries a template's type is the split-off theme's backend package, and the germinal draft's backend shape is built by the germinal theme's earlier rows. If building this needs a change in the templates folder or the template store (for example 'Use template' dispatching to the germinal set), that change is the split branch's to make, not this row's. The start-and-origin area's req-1740 (the germinal origin page's Back link) sat in inc-186 before: the combiner merges that area's draft back into inc-186 as before.

splitOff.why: A sort that really reorders Manage templates changes the Manage templates list, in frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/templates, which theme type-question-and-templates owns; waiting-on-design's touches do not include that folder. It sat in blocked inc-162 and stays blocked on design question 11 on that branch.
